issue_context.title: posix: implement `putpmsg()`
issue_context.body:
This is part of the See [POSIX Roadmap for LTSv3](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/51211) (RFC #51211).

`putpmsg()` is required as part of `_XOPEN_STREAMS` Option Group.

For more information, please refer to https://pubs.opengroup.org/onlinepubs/9699919799/functions/putpmsg.html
comments: I would love to give it a try! Can you please tell me how to get started and how should I approach this?

> I would love to give it a try! Can you please tell me how to get started and how should I approach this?

Awesome! I'm not super familiar with the streams API. I think it would maybe make sense for networking though.

I would suggest first creating this header in `include/zephyr/posix`

https://pubs.opengroup.org/onlinepubs/9699919799/basedefs/stropts.h.html

Then add a 1st commit for the header that adds only the necessary data structures, macros, and types defined for this function.

Then add 2nd commit to implement the function (leave it as a stub to start off with, so make the function return -1 and set errno to `ENOSYS`).

Then add a 3rd commit to tests. These mainly need to ensure conformity to the spec.

I would make a new directory for these tests under `tests/posix/streams`.

Note: Closed my PR to fix some branch issues and stick to the commit style.
